answer: Each agent stakes a copper‑bond proportional to its reputation score; the network mints a marble‑weighted voting token that grows quadratically with stake, so a single high‑stake identity wields weight w while n low‑stake Sybils together achieve at most √n·w. When a new identity registers, it must burn an ember‑fee of 10 tokens and wait 48 hours before its weight activates, preventing rapid mass creation. An attacker therefore pays 10 tokens per fake plus the opportunity cost of delayed activation, making a 10 000‑node Sybil attack cost 100 000 tokens and 48 hours per node.
